component.name: Church Slavonic fonts
component.summary: Fonts for typesetting in Church Slavonic language

description.p: This package provides Unicode-encoded OpenType fonts for Church Slavonic. Fonts contain the necessary glyphs for Cyrillic (including extensions) and Glagolitic, as supported in Unicode 13.0, as well as OpenType features that provide support of ligatures and diacritical marks.
